purpose: Scope manifest for the frozen 2026-11-09 closure snapshot. The gates verify the pinned catalog copy offline, then check that historical versions, reviews, and assessments remain present by ID in the current catalog.
scope_entities_algorithm: sha256 of json.dumps(subset, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':')) where subset = {studies, versions (study_id in scope), reviews (any study_id in scope), assessments (study_id in scope), current_assessments} each restricted to scope ids and sorted by id (current_assessments by study_id, project_id)
note: The full-file and scope hashes refer to 2026-11-09-basis-entities.json. Current pointers and later records belong to the live catalog and do not change those hashes.
